# Email and public forms

Mail the app sends, and forms for people without an account.

- [Email](../reference/email.md#configuration): The app sends mail through one SMTP server or a mailer you supply.
- [Built-in emails](../reference/email.md#protobases-own-mail): Sign-in codes, password resets, invitations and mentions are sent in the app's name.
- [Email templates](../reference/email.md#templates): Your own emails are React components with typed data, sent from jobs, hooks or functions.
- [Public forms](../reference/forms.md#what-the-visitor-sees): A form at its own address lets people without an account create a record, such as a contact request.
- [Bot check](../reference/forms.md#bot-check): Each submission passes a check in the browser, without a third-party service or a puzzle.
- [Form rate limit](../reference/forms.md#rate-limit): Each client sends only a set number of submissions per minute.
